questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This tests practical multitenant QoS design under bursty traffic and storms.

## Key Concepts
- Per-tenant rate limiting with token buckets
- Deficit Round Robin (DRR) scheduling
- Backpressure signaling and per-tenant buffers
- Observability: tail latency, SLA guards, isolation proofs

## Code Example
```javascript
// Pseudo token bucket limiter
class TokenBucket { constructor(rate, burst) { this.rate = rate; this.burst = burst; this.tokens = burst; this.last = Date.now(); }
  consume(n) { this.refill(); if (this.tokens >= n) { this.tokens -= n; return true; } return false; }
  refill() { const now = Date.now(); const add = ((now - this.last) / 1000) * this.rate; this.tokens = Math.min(this.burst, this.tokens + add); this.last = now; }
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you handle tenants joining/leaving and dynamic SLA changes?
- How do you detect and mitigate misbehaving tenants without impacting others?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Assess the ability to design an operational control plane for multi-tenant streaming systems, including per-tenant configurability and safe deployment.

## Key Concepts
- Feature flags at scale for multi-tenant KCNA
- Centralized per-tenant config store and propagation
- Canary rollout gates and safety checks
- Audit logging and rollback mechanisms

## Code Example
```javascript
// Pseudo-code: evaluate if a flag is enabled for a tenant
function isFlagEnabled(tenantId, flagName, defaultVal=false){
  const cfg = fetchTenantConfig(tenantId); // central store (etcd/kv)
  return cfg?.flags?.[flagName] ?? defaultVal;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test rollouts with synthetic tenants and simulate partial failures?
- What observability metrics and dashboards would you add to detect misconfigurations quickly?

Data minimization and regulatory compliance require tenant-scoped retention + deletions with predictable propagation.

- Per-tenant policy store mapping tenant -> TTL/history

## Code Example

  historyLimit: 365
};

- How would you test delete propagation correctness across 3 tenants and 5 topics?
- How would you handle late-arriving delete requests that arrive after tombstone emission?
